description: A stereo tape emulation with bias, saturation, wow and flutter, tone shaping, hiss and an output transformer, the tape type and speed chosen on the menu

params.text: Sets the gain into the tape, from silence through nominal at 1 to three times at the top; past 1 it also brings in the glue compression
Sets how hard the signal is pushed into the saturation stage, 0 to 4
Sets the tape's top end, moving a low pass corner from 200Hz to 20200Hz before the tape type and speed scale it
Sets the level after the transformer stage, silence to two and a half times
Sets how much bias signal is mixed in ahead of the saturation, and tilts the tone with it: above 1 the highs are lifted, below 1 the lows are
Sets the depth of the slow pitch drift, 0 to 1.5
Sets the depth of the fast pitch wobble, 0 to 2.5
Sets the level of the tape hiss added to the output, 0 to 6, quietened to a quarter while the signal is near silence and trimmed further as the tone is closed
Sets the level of the crackling noise bed added to the output, 0 to 6
Scales the pair of shelving filters picked on the menu, -1 to 1, negative settings turning that curve upside down
Sets how hard the output transformer is driven, 0 to 5, and it comes up at 0, which is unity into that stage

inputs.text: The left input, and the only one needed when the right is empty
The right input; with nothing patched here the left input feeds this side too

outputs.text: The processed left channel, or the two inputs averaged and processed once when the right output is empty
The processed right channel, and patching a cable here is also what puts the module into stereo

notes: with the right output empty the module runs in mono: the two inputs are averaged, put through one tape channel and sent to the left output alone. Patch the right output for two channels
menu: Tape Mode: I, II, IV — picks the tape formulation, scaling the bias, drive, tone, hiss, static, wow and flutter and glue together
Tape Style: Vintage, Classic, Modern, Soulless — scales the hiss and static noise floor, Vintage at full and Soulless to nothing at all
Drive and Glue Mode: Single, Mix, Dark — picks the saturation circuit and how much of it is blended back in
Tape Speed: 7.5 IPS, 15 IPS, 30 IPS — a faster speed opens the tone, shrinks the wow and flutter depth and lowers the noise
EQ Curve: Bass, Highs, Mix — picks the pair of shelves the sweetspot knob scales
Transformer: Standard, Dark, Iron — picks which output transformer model the transformer load knob drives

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
